decision: approve exact Windows failed-probe distinction and positive DWORD guard
scope: NULL OpenProcess no longer universally implies shutdown; only recognized invalid-parameter result for positive DWORD PID is treated as absent. Access denied/unknown results refuse replacement. Existing real-handle wait/finally/POSIX unchanged.
source_limits: Microsoft confirms DWORD PID, Idle PID0 invalid-parameter, protected existing processes access-denied, and NULL means failure requiring GetLastError. Positive-PID invalid-parameter absence handling is the proposed guarded interpretation, not a native acceptance claim.
required_checks: Seven actual modeled failures plus known-gone/error87, access-denied/unknown, invalid PID, real handle close, WAIT_FAILED, POSIX and actual-plan refusal controls. No live processes or native Windows claim.
